title: Vitals Measurement Freshness
dataSources: Symptom logs (`condition:symptom`), medication doses (`medication:dose`), vitals readings (`vitals:reading`), flare-up events (`flareup:event`), lab results (`labresult:value`).
app: Chronic-condition self-management — symptom and medication trackers (Bearable, MyTherapy), connected blood-pressure cuffs and glucometers, and lab-result portals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vitals:reading
| stats max(_time) as last_measured by metric
| eval hours_since_measurement=round((now()-last_measured)/3600,1)
| sort - hours_since_measurement
description: Lists which tracked vitals have gone stale because they have not been measured recently enough.
value: Self-management plans often depend on measurement cadence; freshness catches missing readings before trends disappear.
implementation: Use metric labels on `vitals:reading` events and compute hours since last measurement.
visualization: Table of vitals by hours since last reading.
grandmaExplanation: It warns which health readings have gone too long without being checked.
